children: AECOM has been tapped to provide program-management services across three multi-year infrastructure programs for the Adani Group in India.

The programs, which represent a combined capital investment of about $15 billion, will support current efforts to transform India into a leading global economy, the infrastructure-consulting company said Monday.

"AECOM brings deep global expertise in program management across the energy and aviation sectors, underpinned by a strong local presence in India," said Richard Whitehead, chief executive of the company's Europe and India region.

In the first infrastructure program, AECOM will serve as program management consultant for Adani Group's Khavda Renewable Energy Plant in Gujarat, a 30-gigawatt development integrating solar power, wind power and battery energy storage systems.

The second program is expected to deliver four transmission and substation projects across Gujarat and Maharashtra, strengthening the transmission network and helping establish a green energy corridor.

And finally, the third program will support Adani Group's strategic aviation infrastructure expansion across Ahmedabad, Mangaluru and Thiruvananthapuram, supporting the modernization and expansion of airport infrastructure, while enhancing passenger capacity and improving regional connectivity.
